title: IN A PARTY RAID THE BACKPACK SAYS HOW TO OFFER AN ITEM
why: Y on a controller (T on keys) in the backpack offers the selected item to the nearest teammate, but nothing on screen said so: the backpack header named only its own keys. In a party raid it now starts with Y offer to teammate (T on keys), said shorter on a narrow panel. Solo and in the Undercroft the line is as it was.
now: In a party raid the backpack header now says Y offer to teammate on a controller (T on keys).
